title: Ticketmaster outage, Nov 20, 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Ticketmaster, Live Nation, any venue, government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Ticketmaster sells tickets for events across the country, and fans at a stadium show could not get in. Reports came from several states and abroad, events in Mexico City were delayed, and the AFL in Australia called the outage global. Ticketmaster has not said how many people were affected.
who_is_affected: People trying to load Ticketmaster tickets on Friday evening, Nov 20 (ET), most visibly at the Caesars Superdome, two events in Mexico City and a football final in Melbourne. Ticketmaster said service was normal by 12:34 AM ET. On Nov 19, entry was held up in Sioux Falls.

known.text: Ticketmaster's service had an outage on Friday night, Nov 20, that kept fans at the Superdome from loading mobile tickets, according to the event organizer and the venue manager.
Ticketmaster said at 12:34 AM ET on Saturday, Nov 21, that tickets were displaying properly again. It did not say what went wrong.
On Saturday, Nov 21, Ticketmaster told fans to save tickets to a phone wallet before the second Superdome show and said the problem was fixed. It again gave no cause.
Ticketmaster failures also delayed entry at a concert and a music festival in Mexico City that night, according to the venue and the promoter.
On Thursday, Nov 19, a Ticketmaster outage held up entry at the South Dakota state volleyball tournament, according to the tournament's organizer.
The White House said on Nov 18 that it sees no indication of a cyberattack behind recent tech outages. That was before this outage and does not name Ticketmaster.

not_known.text: What caused the outage. Ticketmaster has not said.
Whether it was a cyberattack. No one has claimed one, reported one, or ruled one out.
Whether it is linked to the Nov 19 disruption or to other outages this month.
Whether fans who missed the Nov 20 show will get refunds. WWL asked Ticketmaster and has not reported an answer.
